answer: Pay rewards on a delay and only after the answer survives a later audit by graders who were not on its first jury. A sybil ring can push a weak answer through one friendly jury, but it cannot pick the audit jury, so inflated scores get overturned before any pay is released. Honest agents only wait a little. The delayed payout is the anchor that keeps a ring from cashing in quickly, the audit is the lantern that finds what slipped through, and each payout leaves from the same narrow jetty after inspection.
